camel_example: aliyun vpc ListIpsecServers --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzs372yg0000' --VpnGatewayId 'vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000' --MaxResults 10 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --IpsecServerName test --IpsecServerId.1 'iss-bp1bo3xuvcxo7ixll0000'
description_en: Queries the IPsec servers that have been created
description_zh: 调用ListIpsecServers接口查看已创建的IPsec服务端
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-ipsec-servers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipsec-server-name test --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1q8bgx4xnkm2ogj0000 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --ipsec-server-id iss-bp1bo3xuvcxo7ixll0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpsecServers

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec server.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec服务端所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPsec server.

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec服务端名称。

名称长度为1～100个字符
parameters.name: ipsec_server_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no subsequent query exists.

If a subsequent query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~20，默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec server
parameters.name: ipsec_server_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID of the IPsec server.

The IPsec server belongs to the same resource group as the associated VPN gateway instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2794055.html operation to query the resource group ID of the VPN gateway instance
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec服务端所属的资源组ID。

IPsec服务端与其关联的VPN网关实例的资源组相同。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2794055.html接口查询VPN网关实例所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ClientIpPool.description_en: The client CIDR block, which is the CIDR block from which IP addresses are assigned to the virtual network interface controllers (NICs) of clients
ClientIpPool.description_zh: 客户端网段，指给客户端虚拟网卡分配访问地址的地址段

CreationTime.description_en:
The time when the IPsec server was created.

T is the delimiter and Z indicates UTC (Coordinated Universal Time)
CreationTime.description_zh:
IPsec服务端创建时间。

T表示分隔符，Z表示的是UTC，即世界标准时间

EffectImmediately.description_en:
Indicates whether the current IPsec tunnel is deleted and negotiations are reinitiated.

true: Negotiations are reinitiated after the configuration is complete.

false: Negotiations are reinitiated when traffic is detected
EffectImmediately.description_zh:
是否删除当前已协商成功的IPsec隧道并重新发起协商。

true：配置完成后立即进行协商。

false：当有流量进入时进行协商

IkeMode.description_en:
The IKE version negotiation mode. Valid values:

main: main mode. Negotiations are highly secure
IkeMode.description_zh:
IKE版本协商模式。取值：

main：主模式，协商过程安全性高

LocalId.description_en: The identifier of the IPsec server. The value can be in the FQDN or IP address format. The default value is the public IP address of the selected VPN gateway
LocalId.description_zh: IPsec服务端标识符。支持FQDN和IP地址格式，默认为当前选取的VPN网关公网IP地址

RemoteId.description_en: The identifier of the peer. The value can be in the FQDN or IP address format. The default value is empty
RemoteId.description_zh: 对端标识符。支持FQDN和IP地址格式，默认为空

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the VPN gateway

IpsecServerId.description_en: The ID of the IPsec server

IpsecServerName.description_en: The name of the IPsec server

LocalSubnet.description_en: The local CIDR block, which is the VPC-side CIDR block that needs to communicate with the client CIDR block
LocalSubnet.description_zh: 本端网段，指需要和客户端网段互连的VPC侧的网段

MaxConnections.description_en:
The maximum number of SSL-VPN connections supported by the VPN gateway.
SSL-VPN and the IPsec server share the SSL-VPN connections. For example, if the maximum number of SSL-VPN connections is 5 and three SSL clients are already connected to SSL-VPN, only two more clients can connect to the IPsec server
MaxConnections.description_zh:
VPN网关的SSL连接数规格。
SSL-VPN与IPsec服务端共享SSL连接数。例如，SSL连接数为5，您已经有3个SSL客户端连接了SSL-VPN，则您还能使用2个客户端连接IPsec服务端

MultiFactorAuthEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether two-factor authentication is enabled.

true: Two-factor authentication is enabled.

false: Two-factor authentication is disabled
MultiFactorAuthEnabled.description_zh:
是否已开启双因子认证功能。

true：已开启。

false：未开启

OnlineClientCount.description_en: The number of clients that are connected to the IPsec server
OnlineClientCount.description_zh: 已经连接IPsec服务端的客户端数量

PskEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether pre-shared key authentication is enabled. The value is true, which indicates that pre-shared key authentication is enabled
PskEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启预共享密钥认证方式。仅取值为true，表示开启预共享密钥认证方式

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the IPsec server

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The resource group ID of the IPsec server.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） operation to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
IPsec服务端所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息

VpnGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the VPN gateway

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query exists.

If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。

如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
